reduced_scope_reason: systemd-oomd killed the measurement process repeatedly when openssl was launched via subprocess.Popen from inside a long-running Python monitoring script (even single-process, even 5 trials at 60s, even 3 at 30s) -- root cause appears to be spawning a subprocess from within a script tracked as a background task by the harness, not memory pressure alone (no kernel OOM events, and the same duration/workload succeeded once restructured as bash-native '&' backgrounding + a separate short monitoring call per trial). Reduced to 3 trials x 30s, this pattern, single-process (not -multi 4) openssl to keep each trial short and simple.
